description:
## Problem

The gif? method in src/vug/image_validator.cr creates full 6-byte arrays just to slice them:

data[0..2] == Bytes[0x47, 0x49, 0x46, 0x38, 0x37, 0x61][0..2]

This allocates a 6-byte Bytes literal then slices to 3 bytes for comparison. Unnecessary allocation.

## What to do

1. Replace with direct byte comparisons:
   data[0] == 0x47 && data[1] == 0x49 && data[2] == 0x46
   (GIF87a and GIF89a share the same first 3 bytes: GIF)
2. Simplify the overall logic - the current boolean expression is harder to read than needed
3. Run specs to verify

## Why

- Performance: avoid unnecessary Bytes allocation on every call
- Readability: direct comparisons are clearer than array slicing
title: Simplify ImageValidator.gif? method - unnecessary byte array creation
